A sudden decision was made to hold an early masquerade event! The festivities were [fantastic on the first night](https://i.sli.mg/AcHHfm.jpg)! Everyone was having a great time and not a single cell phone was in sight. Who needs distractions when you [have friends like these](https://i.sli.mg/J5JJPo.jpg)! Alexander enjoyed a little too much of his [private vodka stash](http://bestvodka.net/wp-content/uploads/2012/05/Russian-Standard.jpg) and had to retire early, which was probably for the best.

The meeting was set to take place at 9am at the Russian Embassy in New Delhi, India. Alexander was embarrassingly only 30 minutes early to the embassy. The Indian ambassadors soon arrived and the meeting between the two allies began. Alexander laid out his proposed bullet points for the meeting:

---------------

* Russia would like to assist India with their [shortage of medical staff](https://voat.co/v/ModernPowers/comments/980324). We will send a mix of 500 doctors and nurses to the greater New Delhi area over the next few months and will continue to recruit new volunteers to join the effort.

* We would like to propose joint development on a new mobile science laboratory/rover to be deployed to study the surface of the planet Uranus. We hope that the [ISRO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_Space_Research_Organisation) and [Roscosmos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roscosmos_State_Corporation) can work together on this venture. The project is still in its infancy stage, so planning, cost and time lines would be developed co-operatively between the two space organisations.

* We would like to [improve our student exchange programs](http://in.rbth.com/economics/2015/05/05/russian_and_indian_universities_to_cooperate_in_innovation_42947). We will allocate 664.495.000 RUB ($10,000,000 USD) over the next 4 years for scholarships and grants for Indian students who wish to study at Russian Universities.
